# bob themes

Manage Pomodoro themes and explain task suggestions

```text title="bob themes --help"
Manage Pomodoro themes and explain task suggestions

Bare `bob themes` runs the read-only list. hide, unhide, color, and rename append to the vault journal.

Usage: bob themes [COMMAND]

Commands:
  color    Pin or unpin a theme's hue
  hide     Hide themes from Recent suggestion rows
  list     List remembered Pomodoro themes (default)
  rename   Rename a Pomodoro theme everywhere in one commit
  split    Split one Pomodoro theme across selected entries in one commit
  suggest  Explain the suggested theme for a task or capture route
  unhide   Show hidden themes in Recent suggestion rows again

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob themes` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  bob themes                   Visible themes from the last 90 days
  bob themes -q fix -f json    Rank FIX before FIXES as JSON
  bob themes hide BOOKS        Hide BOOKS from Recent rows
  bob themes unhide BOOKS      Put BOOKS back in Recent rows
  bob themes color BLOG red    Pin BLOG to red
  bob themes color BLOG auto   Drop the BLOG pin
  bob themes rename FIXES FIX -d   Preview a global rename
  bob themes split JOB -t > job.tsv
  bob themes split JOB -m job.tsv -d
  bob themes suggest dev:build    Explain a task’s suggested theme

See docs/pomodoro-themes.md for identity, cache, hue, journal, and JSON.
Run 'bob themes <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob themes color

Pin or unpin a theme's hue

```text title="bob themes color --help"
Pin a Pomodoro theme to a palette slot, or pass auto to drop the pin so the hue rule (config, pin, exempt, unconfigured, area, then name hash) applies again.

The write appends one theme.color event to .bob/themes/<host>.jsonl under bob_sync.lock (wait at most 3s). A pin that already matches is a no-op. A theme whose color comes from the `themes:` block refuses with `config_color`: edit the config file instead.

Usage: bob themes color [OPTIONS] <NAME> <HUE>

Arguments:
  <NAME>
          Theme name as it appears in a Pomodoro tail

  <HUE>
          Palette slot to pin, or auto to unpin

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob themes color BLOG red
  bob themes color BLOG auto
  bob themes color BLOG red -f json

Slots: blue, orange, aqua, yellow, magenta, green, violet, red.

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE         Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins the event timestamp
  HOSTNAME                  Host label for the journal file; same slug vault-sync uses
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock

Exit codes:
  0  wrote the color event
  1  unknown theme, invalid hue, unchanged, config color, lock busy, or I/O failure
  2  usage error

Refusal codes: `unknown_theme`, `invalid_hue`, `unchanged`, `config_color`, `lock_busy`, `io`.

See docs/pomodoro-themes.md for the hue rule and the journal contract.
```

## bob themes hide

Hide themes from Recent suggestion rows

```text title="bob themes hide --help"
Hide one or more Pomodoro themes from Recent suggestion rows only. Today's ledger, typing the name, history, Stats, and colors stay unchanged. Using a hidden name never unhides it.

Each hide appends one theme.hide event to .bob/themes/<host>.jsonl under bob_sync.lock (wait at most 3s). A theme that is already hidden is a no-op.

Usage: bob themes hide [OPTIONS] <NAME>...

Arguments:
  <NAME>...
          Theme name as it appears in a Pomodoro tail

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob themes hide BOOKS
  bob themes hide FIXES BOOKS -f json
  bob themes hide BOOKS --via bob-mac-capture -f json

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE         Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins the event timestamp
  HOSTNAME                  Host label for the journal file; same slug vault-sync uses
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock

Exit codes:
  0  wrote the hide event
  1  unknown theme, unchanged, lock busy, or I/O failure
  2  usage error

See docs/pomodoro-themes.md for hide semantics and the journal contract.
```

## bob themes list

List remembered Pomodoro themes (default)

```text title="bob themes list --help"
List Pomodoro themes derived from canonical daily notes.

A theme is one + component of a Pomodoro name. The catalog is read-only: it never writes the vault. Bare `bob themes` runs this command.

By default the list shows visible themes used in the last 90 days or today, newest first. Hidden themes stay out of the default list; they still exist in history, Stats, and colors. Use --all to include every known theme, --hidden to show only hidden themes, --query to rank exact/prefix matches before substring matches, and --fresh to ignore the machine-local cache. When a `themes:` vocabulary is configured in the config file, the default list also shows every visible configured theme, even ones never used.

Usage: bob themes list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -a, --all
          List every known theme, flagging hidden ones

  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -F, --fresh
          Rebuild the catalog and note-default facts, ignoring caches

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -H, --hidden
          List only hidden themes

  -n, --limit <N>
          Show at most N themes after filtering and ranking

  -q, --query <Q>
          Rank exact and prefix matches first, then substring matches

Examples:
  bob themes
  bob themes list
  bob themes -q fix -f json
  bob themes -a -F
  bob themes -H
  bob themes -n 10 -q bo

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE         Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output
  XDG_CACHE_HOME            Cache root; catalog lives in <cache>/bob-cli/themes/

Exit codes:
  0  list
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  usage or config error

See docs/pomodoro-themes.md for identity, cache, hue, JSON, and journal writers.
```

## bob themes rename

Rename a Pomodoro theme everywhere in one commit

```text title="bob themes rename --help"
Rename one Pomodoro theme across every canonical daily note (past, today, and future, open and closed) plus _templates/daily.md, area and project `theme:` defaults, and `[theme::]` / `(theme::)` task fields (including done/), in a single verified Git commit.

Pomodoro ` — NAME` tails keep their `+` spelling, a resulting duplicate collapses (`FIX + FIXES` → `FIX`), and every other byte is preserved. Note defaults and task fields take NEW's spelling (with `--merge`, fields simply take NEW). Prose, fenced examples, `.bob/`, and `_conflicts/` are never touched.

The preview always rescans from source and counts sessions, defaults, and task themes separately. The write takes bob_sync.lock, pre-syncs unless --offline, snapshots each target and compares again right before writing, writes atomically, appends one theme.rename journal event, verifies by rescanning, makes one commit, then post-syncs. Undo is `git revert`.

Online writes require -b/--bob-dir and BOB_DIR (default ~/bob) to resolve to the same vault; a mismatch refuses before locks or sync. Set BOB_DIR to the selected vault or use --offline. Previews and offline writes do not require this match.

Usage: bob themes rename [OPTIONS] <OLD> <NEW>

Arguments:
  <OLD>
          Current theme name as it appears in a Pomodoro tail

  <NEW>
          New single theme name (must not contain +)

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --dry-run
          Preview the rename without writing, committing, or syncing

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -m, --merge
          Merge OLD into NEW when NEW is already used

  -o, --offline
          Commit locally; skip vault sync before and after

Examples:
  bob themes rename FIXES FIX -d
  bob themes rename FIXES FIX -d -f json
  bob themes rename OLD NEW --merge
  bob themes rename FIXES FIX -o

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE         Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins the event timestamp
  HOSTNAME                  Host label for the journal file; same slug vault-sync uses
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock

Exit codes:
  0  renamed (or dry-run planned)
  1  unknown theme, invalid name, unchanged, theme exists, config reference, lock busy, dirty paths, not a worktree, sync failed, verify failed, stale note, or I/O failure
  2  usage error

See docs/pomodoro-themes.md for the rename contract, refusal table, and revert runbook.
```

## bob themes split

Split one Pomodoro theme across selected entries in one commit

```text title="bob themes split --help"
Rewrite selected Pomodoro theme components in ` — NAME` tails of canonical daily notes (past, today, and future, open and closed) from a tab-separated map, in a single verified Git commit.

`-t/--template` prints a TSV map of every entry whose name contains OLD; it never takes the lock or writes. `_templates/daily.md` is out of scope. Fill the THEME column (an untouched row keeps OLD), then apply with `-m/--map`. `-m -` reads the map from stdin.

Only the OLD component in mapped tails changes: separators keep their `+` spelling, a resulting duplicate collapses (`JOB + BUILD` with THEME BUILD becomes `BUILD`), and every other byte is preserved. Unmapped OLD entries are left alone. Note defaults and `[theme::]` / `(theme::)` task fields are left unchanged; a `split_leaves_task_themes` warning reports leftover counts when OLD still appears there. Split writes no journal event: OLD keeps its hidden state and pin, and every target keeps its own.

The preview and the template always rescan from source. A write takes bob_sync.lock, pre-syncs unless --offline, snapshots each target and compares again right before writing, writes atomically, verifies by rescanning, makes one commit, then post-syncs. Undo is `git revert`.

Online writes require -b/--bob-dir and BOB_DIR (default ~/bob) to resolve to the same vault; a mismatch refuses before locks or sync. Set BOB_DIR to the selected vault or use --offline. Previews, templates, and offline writes do not require this match.

Usage: bob themes split [OPTIONS] <--map <FILE>|--template> <OLD>

Arguments:
  <OLD>
          Theme name to split, as it appears in a Pomodoro tail

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --dry-run
          Preview the split without writing, committing, or syncing

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -m, --map <FILE>
          Tab-separated map of DATE, REF, THEME; - reads stdin

  -o, --offline
          Commit locally; skip vault sync before and after

  -t, --template
          Print a TSV map of OLD entries without writing

Examples:
  bob themes split JOB -t > job.tsv
  bob themes split JOB -m job.tsv -d
  bob themes split JOB -m job.tsv -d -f json
  bob themes split JOB -m - -o

Map format:
  # comment lines and blank lines are skipped
  DATE<TAB>REF<TAB>THEME[<TAB>NOTE]
  DATE is YYYY-MM-DD; REF is LINE:DIGEST; THEME is one + component; NOTE is ignored.

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE         Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  HOSTNAME                  Host label vault-sync uses (split does not write a journal)
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock

Exit codes:
  0  split (or dry-run planned, or template printed)
  1  unknown theme, invalid name, unchanged, stale entry, lock busy, dirty paths, not a worktree, sync failed, verify failed, stale note, or I/O failure
  2  usage error or invalid map

See docs/pomodoro-themes.md for the split contract, map format, refusal table, and revert runbook.
```

## bob themes suggest

Explain the suggested theme for a task or capture route

```text title="bob themes suggest --help"
Explain a task's suggested Pomodoro theme without changing the vault.

Use route:block-id for an existing task, or a bare route for a new task's
default. Task fields take precedence over reading, daily review, and note
defaults. Hidden and unknown themes are reported; closed tasks have no suggestion.

Usage: bob themes suggest [OPTIONS] <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          Capture route or route:block-id (without @ or ^)

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob themes suggest dev
  bob themes suggest dev:build -f json

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE  Exact Bob config file
  BOB_DIR          Vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW          Local datetime override
  NO_COLOR         Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  explanation (including no suggestion or a closed task)
  1  target lookup or I/O failure
  2  usage or config error

See docs/pomodoro-themes.md for the suggestion contract.
```
